verses.text: Paul here, called by God’s will to be an apostle of Jesus Christ—and our brother Sosthenes.
To God’s church in Corinth: you’ve been made holy in Christ Jesus and called to be his holy people, along with everyone everywhere who calls on Jesus our Lord. He’s their Lord and ours too.
Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
I’m always thanking my God for the grace he gave you through Christ Jesus.
Through him you’ve been enriched in every way—in how you speak and what you know.
That’s how Christ’s message got confirmed among you.
So you’re not missing any gift while you wait for our Lord Jesus Christ to show up.
He’ll keep you firm to the finish, with no blame on you on the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
God is faithful. He called you into fellowship with his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.
Family, by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, I’m asking you: get on the same page. Don’t split into factions; come together with one mind and one purpose.
People from Chloe’s household told me, my family, that arguments are breaking out among you.
Here’s what I mean: one of you says, “I’m team Paul”; another, “I’m team Apollos”; another, “I’m team Cephas”; and another, “I’m team Christ.”
Is Christ divided into teams? Was Paul crucified for you? Were you baptized into Paul’s name?
I thank God I baptized none of you except Crispus and Gaius,
so nobody can say you got baptized in my name.
Oh, right—I also baptized Stephanas’s household. Other than that, I can’t remember baptizing anyone else.
Christ sent me to preach the Good News, not to impress people with fancy words, so the cross of Christ wouldn’t lose its power.
The message of the cross sounds ridiculous to people headed for destruction, but to us being saved, it’s God’s power.
Scripture says, “I’ll wreck the wisdom of the wise; I’ll make the clever plans of the clever useless.”
So where’s the wise person? Where’s the Scripture expert? Where’s the debater of this age? God has made the world’s wisdom look foolish.
God, in his wisdom, let the world fail to know him through its own wisdom. So he was glad to save believers through a message the world calls foolish.
Jews ask for signs, and Greeks chase wisdom,
but we preach Christ crucified—a stumbling block to Jews and nonsense to Gentiles.
But to everyone God calls, Jew or Greek, Christ is God’s power and God’s wisdom.
Even what people call God’s foolishness is wiser than human wisdom, and what they call his weakness is stronger than human strength.
Family, look at who God called: not many of you were seen as wise by human standards, not many were powerful, and not many came from important families.
But God chose what the world calls foolish to shame the wise; he chose what the world calls weak to shame the strong.
He chose what’s low-status and looked down on, even what people say doesn’t count, to bring the so-called important things to nothing,
so nobody can flex in front of God.
Because of God, you’re in Christ Jesus. Christ became God’s wisdom for us—our righteousness, holiness, and rescue.
That’s exactly what Scripture says: “If you’re going to brag, brag about the Lord.” 🙌
